'''Jorshem''' will be a Clan Chief in one of Aviendha's visions through the [[Glass columns]]. He has Andoran blood from his grandfather. 

He will live twenty years after the [[Seanchan]] gained the Andoran war machines. When the survivors of the [[Council of Twenty Two]] are discussing what they should do, he says their only hope is the [[Aiel Waste]]
